name: @getpaseo/checked-cli
description: Opt-in Paseo integration and agent-side checked CLI runtime

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild server/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.mjs && esbuild server/runtime.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/runtime.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt index.server.ts server shared package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json vitest.config.ts
